config.title: Surveillance forecasting (simulated): weekly case counts per region and disease, 1-4 weeks ahead
config.description: Fixed before any run. Data: the SIMULATED weekly hospital reports the demo uses (12 simulated regions, 4 hospitals, 3 diseases, 104 weeks ending on the fixed week below, seed 2024, cells under 5 suppressed), aggregated to one series per region and disease (36 series). A regional week with a suppressed hospital cell has no total; such weeks are filled from earlier weeks only when they are inputs and are skipped when they are targets. As in the live forecast, a series is not forecast when more than 20% of its weeks are missing; the share is measured on weeks 1-64 only (the rule is fixed here, before any run). Week numbers count from 1 (the oldest week). Fitting window: weeks 1-64. Validation: forecasts whose target falls in weeks 65-84. Test: forecasts whose target falls in weeks 85-104. Every model is refitted at every forecast origin on all weeks up to and including that origin (rolling origin, expanding window), and forecasts 1-4 weeks ahead; only targets inside the window being scored count. Ensemble weights and the empirical intervals (LSTM, ensemble) use validation forecasts only and are frozen before the test window is scored. All forecasts and interval bounds are clipped at 0 (counts cannot be negative). Reported per model and horizon on the test window: MAE, RMSE, 80% interval coverage, and the MAE ratio against seasonal naive at the same horizon (below 1 = better than seasonal naive). The ensemble is not called better than its members unless the table shows it. One run; the LSTM uses a fixed seed.
